Introducing the......
Arbol Garden Café Experience.

Arbol Eatery is expanding the way we bring food, plants, hospitality, and community together.

The Arbol Garden Café is our plant-forward hospitality experience designed for private events, corporate receptions, garden gatherings, community activations, and curated catering experiences.

Rooted in fresh ingredients, beautiful design, and meaningful connection, Arbol Garden Café brings the feeling of Arbol outside the walls — with chef-prepared bites, greenery, café-style atmosphere, and elevated hospitality.

Interested in bringing the Arbol Garden Café to your home, workplace, garden, or special event? Learn more or contact us today.
